description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure AWS DynamoDB as a grain storage provider within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to add DynamoDB storage as default or named storage, with options to configure storage options.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add DynamoDB grain storage configuration.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use AWS DynamoDB as the default grain storage with custom options.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the service collection to add a DynamoDB-based grain storage with specified name and options.
